title: REFINE-LM: Mitigating Language Model Stereotypes via Reinforcement Learning
findings: All tested language models exhibited significant stereotypical biases related to religion. The proposed method, REFINE-LM, consistently and significantly reduced the intensity of these biases across all models and for the vast majority of religious groups, bringing the bias scores closer to zero (a fair model) without hurting performance on downstream tasks.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured stereotypical bias by evaluating a language model's probability distribution on under-specified questions. These questions associated subjects from different religious groups (e.g., 'muslim', 'christian') with various stereotypical attributes in a masked-token prediction task, based on the UnQover framework.
